## Which file do I need?

Cognitive Terrain runs in your web browser. Nothing to install.

| You want to… | Download |
|---|---|
| Play straight away on any computer | **cognitive-terrain-0.18.3.html**, then double-click it to open in your browser |
| Read the rules | **Cognitive-Terrain-Field-Manual-0.18.3.pdf** |
| A one-sheet summary to print, two-sided | **Cognitive-Terrain-Player-Aid-0.18.3.pdf** |
| Run it for a group, build campaigns, see why it works | **Cognitive-Terrain-Practitioners-Manual-0.18.3.pdf** |
| Hear each week read aloud (optional) | the **Immersive Briefings** voice pack, on its own release: **voice-emma-1** |

Two-player games work as long as both players use a 0.18 build (0.18.0, 0.18.1 and so on).

## What's new

- **A new start screen.** Campaigns sit in a column on the left, grouped by
  opponent, with the first campaign marked START HERE. Behind them the
  opponent's mind is live on the map. The chosen campaign's story, twist and four crises (a calendar of
  the 16 weeks, with the area each crisis tests) sit at the bottom, and one
  bar holds Words, Difficulty, Skip tutorial and START WITH TUTORIAL. Two
  players, Campaigns, Guide and Settings are four buttons under the list.
  Sound settings moved to Settings. New campaign uses the same screen.
- **Every dialog in the same frame.** A short sand line says what each one is
  for, then a big title, clean sections, and an action bar with one sand
  button.
  - **Settings** in five sections: Display, Words, Sound, Briefings, Pace.
  - **New technology** shows how disruptive the research scores it: each of
    the four attributes rated 1 to 3 with what it measures, and the total S
    on a meter with the flag at 9.
  - **The full story of a move** shows how the spread grade is worked out:
    the F to A+ scale with the score each grade needs and how hard it pushes,
    the formula, and this move's own numbers run through it.
  - **Crisis**, **Week in review**, **Two players**, **Campaigns** and the
    **debrief** follow the same layout; the debrief keeps every section,
    including the replay with both minds.
  - The result card after each move stays, in the same frame.
- Tutorial, Field Manual, Practitioner's Manual and Player Aid updated, with
  every picture retaken. No rule changes: two-player codes work between 0.18
  builds.
